headline: Ye is projected to surpass 1 MILLION in total attendance across his shows this year 🤯🔥 W
body:
Ye is projected to surpass 1 MILLION in total attendance across his shows this year 🤯🔥

With both Chicago nights included, the estimates for the stops listed add up to 1,089,000+ attendees 🌎

Tonight’s sold-out Soldier Field show is expected to push that total past the million mark, with another Chicago show tomorrow 🏟️

📸: Getty Images / @ehstehfan / @cambamscam
